stem: Meera spills some water on the dry mud courtyard of her house on a hot afternoon. After some time, the water is no longer visible. What has most likely happened to the water?

options.text: It has only seeped into the mud surface.
It has only evaporated into the air as water vapour.
It has partly seeped into the porous mud and partly evaporated into the air.
It has turned into ice inside the mud.

teacher.key_rationale: A dry mud courtyard is porous, so some water seeps in; the hot afternoon also causes evaporation, so both processes remove the visible water. The key is C.
